title: The National Commission for Women Act, 1990

Department: Department of WOMAN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT Enforcement Date: 31-01-1992 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Women and Child Development, ) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 31st January, 1992, vide notification No. S.O. 99(E), dated 31st January, 1992, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii). Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Constitution of the National Commission for Women. Section 4. Term of office and conditions of service of Chairperson and Members. Section 5. Officers and other employees of the Commission. Section 6. Salaries and allowances to be paid out of grants. Section 7.
